earth.name: Earth
earth.description: Solid and defensive element. Strong against Dark, weak to Water.

water.name: Water
water.description: Fluid and adaptive element. Strong against Earth, weak to Fire.

fire.name: Fire
fire.description: Aggressive and destructive element. Strong against Water, weak to Light.

light.name: Light
light.description: Pure and radiant element. Strong against Fire, weak to Dark.

dark.name: Dark
dark.description: Mysterious and corrupting element. Strong against Light, weak to Earth.

wind.name: Wind
wind.description: Amplifier element. Increases damage of all other elements by 30%.
